items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 with ankle injury (high-ankle sprain context from prior).
items.why: ETR weekend injury summary; missed third straight.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts again; Zay Flowers WR2 range without Lamar.
items.opportunity: Huntley pass volume; Flowers/Andrews targets stable but lower ceiling.

items.text: Puka Nacua ACTIVE after GTD/optimism listing with calf; played vs Raiders.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; reverse any Davante/backup beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets with Stafford; no snap share drop assumed.

items.text: Breece Hall INACTIVE (GTD/pessimism) for third straight week with quad.
items.why: ETR summary; Schefter listed among inactives.
items.implication: Braelon Allen lead back again; full opportunity.
items.opportunity: Allen snaps/carries/routes elevated; Jets RB committee tilts fully.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT (hamstring/ankle) for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Rap/Schefter activation notes for other Eagles but these out.
items.implication: Eagles WR corps thinned; Goedert/Calcaterra/Stowers elevated, Lemon potential.
items.opportunity: TE snaps/routes up; slot/outside targets redistribute to remaining WRs/TEs.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos snaps 50%/rush 41%/routes 34%; JK Dobbins only 21% snaps. Coleman LOVE/upgrade, roster in 100%.
items.why: Berry Love/Hate + usage post-return; Coleman lead role.
items.opportunity: Coleman snap/rush/route lead post-IR; Dobbins reduced.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant, day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely short absence; Mason/others temporary if misses.
items.opportunity: Vikings RB committee shift short-term if out.

items.text: Seahawks/Broncos/Vikings/Packers potential JT suitors per Schefter trade deadline names; Jadarian Price chest, eligible return W8, window opening, SEA needs weapons beyond JSN.
items.why: Levitan on Schefter video; Macdonald opening Price 21-day window.
items.implication: JT trade elevates Indy backups; Price stash if SEA adds or activates.
items.opportunity: Price practice/activation path; JT handcuffs if moved.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) on OT slide/run but not certain severity; expected OK with bye.
items.why: Levitan assessment; Garafolo/others: should be OK, no strain, bye helps.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 9; lead back role intact if healthy.
items.opportunity: If limited, Tracy/Singletary/others reverse prior elevation.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; coach/player confirm checked and good, pain resolved.
items.why: Levitan on ETR watch list; Campbell 'should be good', Gibbs 'fine' postgame.
items.implication: No missed time expected; full RB1 for Week 8.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring) for MNF; listed expected after Q.
items.implication: Normal RB1 workload if active; reverse handcuff elevation.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch RB: worst runner efficiency but RB13 PPR PPG via 9 carries inside 5 and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Goal-line + target volume sustain fantasy despite poor YPC.
items.implication: Sustainable RB2/flex via opportunity, not efficiency.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/goal-line + receiving work elite for position.

items.text: Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; turn big game into sell-high opportunity.
items.why: Berry Pregame take on big performance.
items.implication: Peak trade value post-explosion; not sustainable long-term.

items.text: Texans routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24, Noel 15 (turf toe early exit), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, M. Harrison 8, Tank Dell 6 (return).
items.why: Nico clear lead; Dell limited in first game back.
items.implication: Nico WR1 locked; Dell slow ramp, watch Noel toe.
items.opportunity: Nico route/target dominance; Dell handcuff/spot start only if volume rises.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game sans Rice); never topped 83 rec yds in 37 career games.
items.why: Route lead without Rashee Rice; ceiling note on historical production.
items.implication: High opportunity but efficiency/ceiling capped historically; WR2/flex with volume.
items.opportunity: Primary route runner; targets/red-zone potential elevated in Rice absence.
items.conflict: High routes vs low historical yards ceiling.
